nitroxanalyser.changelog: Free O2 analysis is now limited to a displayed 39.9% on the device and in the browser. From 40.0%, free mode shows PRO instead of the O2 and browser MOD readings; existing Pro licences retain the full range. Shortens the activation email hint so it no longer wraps onto the sensor millivolt row.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Adds offline date/time entry and one-click phone/computer clock sync in Settings, with optional battery-backed RTC storage. Manual time is used for labels and replaced automatically by internet time when available. Improves printer preparation and B1 battery reporting.
